audiences_age_range_valid.name: audiences_age_range_valid
audiences_age_range_valid.value: ("audiences"."minimum_age" is null or "audiences"."minimum_age" >= 0) and ("audiences"."maximum_age" is null or "audiences"."maximum_age" >= coalesce("audiences"."minimum_age", 0))

book_relationships_active_approval.name: book_relationships_active_approval
book_relationships_active_approval.value: not "book_relationships"."active" or ("book_relationships"."approved_by" is not null and "book_relationships"."approved_at" is not null and nullif(btrim("book_relationships"."public_reason"), '') is not null)

media_assets_dimensions_together.name: media_assets_dimensions_together
media_assets_dimensions_together.value: ("media_assets"."width" is null and "media_assets"."height" is null) or ("media_assets"."width" is not null and "media_assets"."height" is not null)

recommendation_feedback_rating_valid.name: recommendation_feedback_rating_valid
recommendation_feedback_rating_valid.value: ("recommendation_feedback"."action" = 'rating' and "recommendation_feedback"."rating" between 1 and 5) or ("recommendation_feedback"."action" <> 'rating' and "recommendation_feedback"."rating" is null)
